name: (table)
description: metadata about extracellular electrodes

name: location
description: the location of channel within the subject e.g. brain region

name: group
description: a reference to the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: group_name
description: the name of the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: x
description: the x coordinate of the position (+x is posterior)

name: y
description: the y coordinate of the position (+y is inferior)

name: z
description: the z coordinate of the position (+z is right)

name: imp
description: the impedance of the electrode, in ohms

name: filtering
description: description of hardware filtering, including the filter name and frequency cutoffs

name: (table)
description: Autogenerated by NWBFile

name: snr
description: Signal-to-noise ratio

name: n_spikes
description: Number of spikes in the entire recording

name: quality
description: Quality label from Bombcell pipeline

name: channel
description: Closest electrode channel id

name: brain_region
description: Assigned AIBS CCFv3 brain region acronym

name: x
description: x location in AIBS CCFv3 brain atlas

name: y
description: y location in AIBS CCFv3 brain atlas

name: z
description: z location in AIBS CCFv3 brain atlas

name: spike_times
description: the spike times for each unit

name: (table)
description: experimental intervals

name: start_time
description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

name: stop_time
description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

name: stimulus
description: Type of stimulus delivered

name: Ketamine infusion start
description: Approximate timepoint of manual infusion of ketamine bolus
